name: io.github.goldmarklabs/crispparse
title: CrispParse
description: Web extraction to Markdown & RAG chunks with C2PA v2.4 provenance and x402 Base USDC.

tools.name: crispparse_extract
tools.description: Deterministic 3-tier web extraction (Markdown, JSON, Hybrid, CSS selectors) with C2PA v2.4 provenance.

url.description: Target HTTP or HTTPS URL to extract.

mode.description: Output format mode: markdown, json, or hybrid.

selectors.description: Optional CSS selector map of field names to CSS expressions.

bypass_cache.description: Set true to bypass cached extraction and fetch fresh content.

api_key.description: Optional CrispParse Macaroon API key (falls back to x402 payment if omitted).

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 Base Mainnet USDC payment signature header.

block_prompt_injection.description: Sanitize untrusted page directives to guard against indirect prompt injection.

tools.name: crispparse_extract_fast
tools.description: Fast Tier-1 static Markdown extraction (1 credit / $0.00165 Base USDC) with C2PA v2.4 provenance.

url.description: Target HTTP or HTTPS URL for fast static Markdown extraction.

bypass_cache.description: Set true to bypass cached extraction and fetch fresh content.

api_key.description: Optional CrispParse Macaroon API key (falls back to x402 payment if omitted).

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 Base Mainnet USDC payment signature header.

block_prompt_injection.description: Sanitize untrusted page directives to guard against indirect prompt injection.

tools.name: crispparse_claim_trial
tools.description: Claim a 50-credit CrispParse trial Macaroon token (14-day TTL) with no signup or credit card.

force_refresh.description: Request a fresh trial token status check if already issued.

tools.name: crispparse_balance
tools.description: Check remaining Macaroon credit balance, active tier, and requests-per-second limit.

api_key.description: CrispParse Macaroon API key to inspect.

tools.name: crispparse_verify
tools.description: Cryptographically verify a detached C2PA v2.4 provenance manifest returned by CrispParse.

provenance.description: Detached C2PA v2.4 provenance JSON object to verify.
